content.text:
**#402: yes, it can be closed.** It asked for a patch release. v0.38.1 never shipped: its version bump reached `main`, but the tag was never created, and no `v0.38.1` tag exists on the remote. v0.39.0 replaces it and contains everything v0.38.1 would have. One small leftover: `CHANGELOG.md` still has a `## [0.38.1]` section for a version that was never tagged. You can fold it into 0.39.0 or leave it.

**#409: not yet.** The fix from #410 is in v0.39.0, but two things are missing:

1. **No live Pi check yet.** #410 says "Refs #409" rather than closing it, because it changes what the model and the transcript see. Under the delivery rules for this repo, the issue stays open until someone has checked it in a running Pi session, and nobody has.
2. **It doesn't cover pi-durable.** The new check (`src/context/imitated-calls.ts`) runs only on regular Pi. pi-durable (`src/durable/`) has no such check. It also writes finished calls in a second format, `[Pit: collapsed …]`, which the check wouldn't recognise even if it ran there. pi-action uses pi-durable, so the failure #409 describes can still happen there with no notice.

I'd close #402 now. For #409, I'd either extend the fix to pi-durable or split that into its own issue, then close #409 after a live check. I can do any of these if you like. I haven't closed anything or changed any code in this run.
